The '''Quiberon sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and included the [[Quiberon system/Legends|Quiberon]] and [[Rothana system/Legends|Rothana systems]]. It was formerly incorporated as a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and the declassification of the world of [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]], until then a secret planet kept by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for covert projects.<ref name="TEGtW" />
